servicesSection.title: Every surface, every system, spotless.
servicesSection.subtitle: Six specialised service lines, one standard of care.

domestic-water-tank.name: Domestic & Drinking Water Tank Cleaning
domestic-water-tank.short: Safe, hygienic water storage for homes and apartments.
domestic-water-tank.overview: Our expert cleaning process removes sediment, biofilm, and harmful microbes from your overhead and underground water tanks — making sure every drop that reaches your tap is safe.
features: Thorough tank inspection to identify leaks, cracks and contamination
High-pressure jet washing to dislodge sludge and sediment
Food-grade sanitisation that eliminates bacteria and pathogens
Compliance with WHO and IS 10500 drinking water standards
Before-and-after photo report for your records

stp-fire-tank.name: STP & Fire Tank Cleaning
stp-fire-tank.short: System efficiency for sewage treatment plants and fire reserves.
stp-fire-tank.overview: From municipal STPs to building fire reserves — we handle sludge removal, odour control and regulatory-grade inspection so your safety systems are always audit-ready.
features: Complete sludge and grit removal from STP chambers
Odour neutralisation using enzyme-based treatment
Fire tank debris clearance and structural inspection
Safety testing and compliance documentation
Regulatory adherence for CPCB, MPCB and fire NOC audits

industrial-cooling-tower.name: Industrial Tank & Cooling Tower Cleaning
industrial-cooling-tower.short: Advanced solutions engineered for industrial-scale needs.
industrial-cooling-tower.overview: Tailored cleaning for process tanks, chillers and cooling towers. We optimise heat-transfer efficiency while keeping downtime to the absolute minimum.
features: Scale and biofilm removal from cooling tower fills
Legionella risk reduction protocols
Confined-space-entry certified technicians
Chemical descaling with corrosion-safe formulations
Minimal downtime — night-shift and weekend scheduling

facade-cleaning.name: Facade & High-Rise Cleaning
facade-cleaning.short: Glass, stone, and composite facades restored to new.
facade-cleaning.overview: From glass towers to stone-clad heritage structures — our rope-access and aerial-lift teams restore facade clarity while respecting architectural finishes and safety norms.
features: IRATA-trained rope-access technicians
Cherry-picker and BMU operations for high-rises
Biodegradable, surface-specific cleaning agents
Glass, ACP, stone, granite and stucco expertise
Public liability insurance and zero-incident safety protocol

deep-cleaning.name: Deep Cleaning for Homes & Offices
deep-cleaning.short: Every inch thoughtfully scrubbed, sanitised and renewed.
deep-cleaning.overview: Professional deep cleaning for flats, bungalows and offices — from kitchen degreasing to upholstery care, we use eco-friendly agents and modern equipment.
features: Comprehensive dusting, vacuuming and sanitisation
Kitchen and pantry degreasing with food-safe products
Washroom scrubbing and disinfection
Upholstery, sofa, carpet and mattress shampooing
Non-toxic, pet-safe eco-friendly cleaning agents

solar-water-heater.name: Solar Water Heater Service
solar-water-heater.short: Reliable servicing and repairs for all solar systems.
solar-water-heater.overview: Keep your solar water heater running at peak efficiency — we service and repair all brands and configurations, on rooftops across the city.
features: Evacuated tube replacement and realignment
Tank descaling and inner-liner inspection
Valve, sensor and controller repair
Leak detection and plumbing fixes
Annual maintenance contracts available

whyUs.title: Quiet expertise. Loud results.
whyUs.subtitle: Fifteen years of practice, one standard of care.
pointsBody: A quality management system audited against international benchmarks — the same standard expected of hospitals and food processors.
Every technician carries safety training, confined-space certification and public liability cover. No contractors, no surprises.
We specify biodegradable and food-grade agents wherever humans, pets or potable water are involved — without compromising on result.
Photo and video documentation, water-quality test results, and a digital service report — delivered to your inbox within 24 hours.

steps.title: Inspect
steps.body: We visit your site, assess the surface or system, and quote in writing — no call-out fee.

steps.title: Plan
steps.body: A scheduled slot that minimises disruption, with clear safety and access arrangements.

steps.title: Execute
steps.body: Trained crew, specified chemistry, documented controls. We bring everything we need.

steps.title: Report
steps.body: Photo evidence, water-quality results where relevant, and a digital service certificate.

about.title: Built on trust, measured in clarity.
about.intro: Shree Chintamani Services was founded on a simple belief: clean water and clean spaces are fundamental rights, not luxuries. Today, we are a team of trained professionals serving homes, commercial buildings, and industrial facilities across Pune and the wider Maharashtra region.
about.missionBody: To provide reliable, eco-friendly cleaning solutions that ensure safety, hygiene, and customer satisfaction — contributing to a cleaner, healthier future.
about.visionBody: To become Maharashtra's most trusted name in professional cleaning — an organisation where every client receives transparent service, every technician is treated with respect, and every job reflects our commitment to quality.
